[i]Drimmons would pull out a document from a folder before presenting it to the Sikirsk delegation[/i]

[b]Plan for Peace 2025 (v.2)[/b]

In order to ensure a lasting peace between Thýven and Sikirsk it is hereby requested of Sikirsk.

1.) Sikirsk and Thýven establish a mutual counter-terrorism effort, funded and backed by the governments of both nations.

2.) Sikirsk permits the establishment of a base of operations consisting of 45,000 personnel and their families on the mainland in order to aid in THEP anti-terrorism actions.
        2a. This base shall serve also as a potential economic port between Thýven and Sikirsk in order to aide in the further development of the Sikirskian Economy.

3.) In return for these actions, Thýven shall pay up to 2 Billion Gilder to the government of Sikirsk for any damages incurred during the brief (and unjust) war by Thýven.
